column1: # row-runners.tsv: which one-call runner script runs which imm26 row (read by rowcard.py -> row-card.sh / next-row.sh / lane-brief.ps1).
# Format: row | script (under testing/live-stobe-queue/imm26-assert/rowtools/ unless it starts with testing/ or ../) | extra args (<ready> = the lane's ready save) | note
# Newest recipe wins (a later runner overrides an older one for the same row). A row listed in rowdefs.sh/tripdefs.sh but not here falls back to go-row.sh.
# Add a row = one line here (no script is edited). Runners print ONE `RESULT <row> PASS|FAIL|SETUP-FAIL|GATED <evidence>` line; exit 0/1/2/3, 4 = ROW-NEEDS-FIXER.
# trip family (README_TRIP.md): reloads the ready save first (i3/i4 default; other lanes need --save)
08-d | unblockrun_a.sh | --save <ready> | add --neg for the negative leg
10-b | unblockdefs_e.sh | --save <ready> | run the defs file itself (sfD2)
15-bx | unblockdefs_c_v4.sh | --save <ready> | run the defs file itself (v4 = v3c + F1 pin, imm26-fix15bxv5; v1 unblockdefs_c.sh left X in the fight scene: imm26-investigate-15bx-witness)
20-a | unblockdefs_c.sh | --save <ready> | run the defs file itself (u-rowsC)
# hardening rows (README_HX.md): the base save is the lane's hx save (i3 kah-imm26-5090-hxA, i4 kah-imm26-i4-hx0)
13-ax | hxrun.sh | --save <hx save> --saves "s1 s2 s3 s4 s5" |
# imm26-fix22b: 22-b participation-qualified walk (sfr22b_keep.sh keeps Shay within 35 u for the whole native walk); selftest sfr22b_v4_selftest.sh 14/14
22-b | sfrrun_v4.sh | --save <ready> | fix22b v4: needs plan_report fix deployed (lib md5 40f933f7/92a3b8cc) + sftrav inject on lane
